verdict.rationale: The pack shows no documented system-to-system channel for software to transact (file) with the Colorado SOS: there is no system-account, transmitter, or batch-provider program and no published enrollment path. The prepaid account application, the mass-change registered agent PDF form, and the read-only Socrata open-data API are adjacent features (payment account, paper batch form, and host-platform data access), not a transactional machine channel.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
